description:
Free intent-level preflight planner for SAP MCP. Call before paid calls, swaps, registry writes, escrow, identity updates, external x402 calls, premium streams, or transaction finalization. It returns the correct hosted/local route, fresh-data requirements, max-price guidance, confirmation policy, retry rules, proof-tape shape, and forbidden actions without charging x402.

SAP MCP execution guidance: Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required.

inputSchema.description: Prepare SAP MCP Action input schema. Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required. Use exact field names from this schema; do not guess aliases or include private key material.

estimatedNotionalUsd.description: Optional estimated trade, escrow, or value-moving notional in USD for confirmation-policy guidance.

hasSubmittedSignature.description: Set true when a transaction signature was already submitted. The planner will route to verification before any retry.

hasUnsignedTransaction.description: Set true when a hosted builder already returned unsigned transaction bytes that should be finalized locally.

intent.description: Closest user intent. Use registry-write for agent registration, update-agent for profile/image updates, swap for token swaps, escrow for SAP Escrow V2, external-x402 for third-party x402 agents, and premium-stream for premium plugin streams/webhooks.

maxPriceUsd.description: Optional user or policy x402 spend cap for this planned action. Agents should normally estimate first and use estimate × 1.25.

toolName.description: Exact hosted or local tool name being planned, such as jupiter_getOrder, sap_update_agent, sap_create_escrow_v2, or sap_payments_register_agent.

userGoal.description: Short user-facing goal in natural language, used only to tailor the plan and proof-tape shape.

name: sap_prepare_action

confirmationPolicy.description: Whether confirmation is required and why.

freePreflightTools.description: Free tools that should be called before paid/write execution for this intent.

freshDataRequired.description: Fresh data that must be fetched before user-facing claims, payment, signing, or execution.

maxPricePolicy.description: How to set maxPriceUsd and when to estimate paid call cost.

paidOrWriteRoute.description: Canonical paid/write route, including local bridge or hosted builder path.

proofTapeTemplate.description: Audit object shape the agent should fill during execution.

retryRules.description: Safe retry rules for x402, RPC, hosted signer guards, and submitted signatures.

sessionContextPacket.description: Shared SAP MCP session routing, freshness, memory, and forbidden-action rules.

success.description: Whether the action preparation plan was generated.

toolName.description: Tool name provided for the planned action, or null when omitted.

userFacingPreviewShape.description: Fields that should appear in a compact human preview before value-moving work.

userGoal.description: Goal provided by the user, or null when omitted.

title: Prepare SAP MCP Action
